research_result.description: Fathom provides meeting recording, transcription, and summary insights via a REST API, official SDKs, webhooks, and an official MCP server.
research_result.credential_requirements: Users can generate API keys directly in the Fathom account settings area. Developers building multi-tenant integrations can register an OAuth app to obtain client credentials.

evidence.claim: Fathom SDKs support API Key authentication.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Authenticate with the Fathom SDKs using API keys

evidence.claim: Fathom SDKs and API support Bearer Token authentication.
Fathom supports OAuth 2.0 authentication for multi-account integrations.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Both TypeScript and Python SDKs support OAuth 2.0 authentication for building integrations that can be installed by multiple Fathom accounts.

evidence.claim: API access is self-serve and open to anyone via account settings and documentation.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Anyone can browse the API docs and start building!

evidence.claim: Developers can generate an API key and begin making API calls quickly.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Generate an API key and make your first call in minutes.
This documentation describes Fathom's REST API.

evidence.claim: Fathom offers an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Fathom now offers an official MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, allowing you to connect your Fathom meeting data to AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, and more.
